description: Embedded control system -- adversarial dual. Can the component failures (now the coalition) FORCE the system down, against a repairing controller (now the adversary)? Expected UNKNOWN/FALSE: the controller repairs one component per round, so the failures cannot drive the redundancy to zero. Qualitative core of the PRISM P=?[ F down ] (the probability of failure is not forced to 1). Soundness dual of <ctrl>G{operational == 1}.
